def: properly, a hider, i.e. (abstractly) a hiding, i.e. aversion

words.word: and we hid as it were

occurrences.text: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
